caseName: Estes v. Metropolitan Branches of the Dallas NAACP
caseNameFull: Estes v. Metropolitan Branches of the Dallas NAACP Curry v. Metropolitan Branches of the Dallas NAACP and Brinegar v. Metropolitan Branches of the Dallas NAACP

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of respondents Tasby et al. for leave to proceed in forma pau-peris in No. 78-253 granted. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and these petitions. Reported below: 572 F. 2d 1010.
